items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: We split up. Frank Pasley, he went to Chicago.

ctx.x: That was a sub year, around 1923. So, after we left Devonport, we started booking dances. After our contract was up, we started booking dances, playing theaters all over the state of Oklahoma. We got a booking agent, and we played such theaters like the Rialto in Tulsa. The first real theater I ever played in, and they gave us a nice write-up. It was crazy about the jazz band.
